central_thesis_conclusion: In the project's causal, long-only, buy-only, fully funded, same-deposit, cash-inclusive comparison model, universal dominance over every finite positive price path forces DCA itself. The sharp epsilon-DCA unit guardrail preserves a chosen relative-wealth floor and creates a funded discretionary interval, while the terminal-inventory boundary shows that realized adaptive performance is fixed by terminal cash and units. The reviewed empirical layers find no universal, optimal, or confirmed incremental superiority for the corrected-mean signal.

complete_system.conclusion: The complete system is path-sensitive in deterministic and controlled stochastic evidence; its median relative-wealth gap was negative in all 18 non-unit primary frictionless historical cells.

corrected_mean_signal.conclusion: The corrected-mean selector has parameter- and path-sensitive finite effects, but no multiplicity-adjusted H2 evidence of incremental historical value in the sealed run.

frictionless_relative_wealth_floor.interpretation: finite aggregate audit of the proved epsilon-DCA floor; not a new proof

historical_inference.dependence_boundary: overlapping monthly windows; no independent-sample interpretation
historical_inference.method: registered circular moving-block bootstrap with one 36-test H1/H2 Holm family

interpretation_boundaries: Do not pool episode rows, sample counts, or inferential units across evidence layers, families, assets, horizons, or schedules; unweighted descriptive summaries of retained cell-level statistics are permitted only with ranges and an explicit non-inferential label.
Deterministic signs are finite stress outcomes, not frequencies.
Stochastic rows are controlled sensitivity over saved seeds, not calibrated market probabilities.
Historical windows overlap; only the 36 registered H1/H2 cells use dependence-aware inference.
Robustness and exploratory rows do not enter the sealed H1/H2 multiplicity family.
Net-of-cost rows are empirical results outside the current epsilon-DCA theorem.
Terminal cash and unit components are ledger-conditioned identities, not causal explanations.
No result establishes parameter optimality, expected performance, or universal superiority or inferiority.

safety_architecture.conclusion: The guardrail supplies the model-free floor; the neutral architecture's median relative-wealth gap was negative in all 18 non-unit primary frictionless historical cells, a descriptive secondary result.
